params.name: formulaString
params.description: Text formula to be returned as object

sentinelValues.meaning: the formula executes in the context it was created (default behavior when context is omitted)
the formula executes in the context of the host database -- useful when the formula is created inside a component

overloads.semanticRole: Creates a 4D.Function object from a text-based formula, executed by default in the context (database/component) where it was created.
The Formula from string command creates a 4D.Function object based upon the formulaString and, optionnally, a context .

constraints: Prefer the Formula command over this one unless the original formula is stored as text (e.g. in an external JSON file) or a formula must be created in a host database while calling from a component.
Local variable contents cannot be accessed by name in compiled mode, so they cannot be used inside formulaString -- attempting to reference a local variable raises error -10737.
Using tokens in formulaString syntax is strongly advised.
